climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

climate: Rain picks up at harvest. Growers race to pick before rot sets in, and vintages vary more.

blurb.text: A Veneto white wine denomination from nine communes including Peschiera del Garda and Lazise. Its rules allow still and sparkling wine from grapes such as Garganega, Trebbiano, Chardonnay and Pinot Bianco.
